soldier: Head brown, nasus deep brown, the longitudinal stripe in the middle of the head pale; thorax and abdomen pale brown, legs paler. Hairs on the head very sparse, a few hairs at the tip of the nasus. Large form: head flatly rounded, the sides swollen, the middle of the posterior margin shallowly concave; nasus a round tube, about two thirds as long as the head, slightly turned up, the base of the nasus depressed, the mandibles with a long apical spine. Antennae with 13 segments, segment 3 twice as long as segment 2. The anterior lobe of the pronotum strongly sclerotised, the median incision shallow. Medium form similar to the large form, the nasus extending straight forwards, its tip below the vertex, the base of the nasus flat; antennae with 13 to 14 segments. Small form similar to the medium form but paler, the nasus extending straight, the apical spine of the mandibles blunt or absent.
taxonomy_note: The original work placed it in the genus Mironasutitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Nasutitermes.
